items.html: And behold, after these three YAHU are in the Yesod of Hochma, which is the palate, then He gives them in the secret of coupling to the Malchut within it, which is the throat, which is the Bina of the entirety of Arich as a whole. Also understand now the secret of the field of holy apples, for the field of holy apples is always the secret of Malchut, in that she nurses from the three lower NHY, when she is then called “field.” As is explained by us in the matter of receiving the Sabbath. And it is in the secret of these three YAHU that become a field, in that they are together in NHY.
